provenance.scope: ALTER COLUMN TYPE original-row transforms and action order; repeated type/typmod changes, dropped inputs, volatile expressions and defaults, new constraints, inheritance with different child layouts and diamonds, external parents, ONLY and partition diagnostics, statement/savepoint rollback, indexes and durable reopen. A 256-row 4KiB-payload rewrite at work_mem=64kB preserves every transformed row and index lookup before and after reopening. Transaction-private updates/deletes/inserts, unaffected versus rebuilt foreign keys, and per-relation visibility of volatile parent transforms. A callback row inserted after a same-name DROP/ADD reads NULL from the old column slot; failed nested callback INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE effects are excluded while its exception-handler insert is rewritten. Same-relation callback INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/key relocation is replaced by the retained rewrite input; virtual-only TYPE actions still publish added or changed stored-generated values, including after DROP EXPRESSION and reopen. Unrelated stored-generated foreign keys are not revalidated by payload or virtual type changes; changing the stored generation expression validates its actual new key and rolls back both schema and rows on failure.
